description: Figure 3 is a grouped vertical bar chart illustrating the results of an ablation study across two datasets. The horizontal x-axis contains the categories, which are divided into two main groups separated by a vertical dashed line: "PHEME" on the left and "PolitiFact" on the right. Within each dataset group, there are six model configurations with diagonally oriented labels: "Ours", "w/o comments", "w/o text", "w/o select", "w/o emotion", and "w/o cognition". The vertical y-axis represents "Accuracy (%)" on a linear scale ranging from 75.0 to 95.0, with tick marks and corresponding horizontal background grid lines at regular intervals of 2.5 units. The bars are color-coded according to their configuration: "Ours" is dark red, "w/o comments" is light red, "w/o text" is light yellow, "w/o select" is light blue, "w/o emotion" is medium blue, and "w/o cognition" is dark blue. Each bar is visually emphasized with its exact numerical value annotated directly above it. In the PHEME group, the bar values are 89.84, 86.82, 80.10, 88.80, 87.34, and 87.17, respectively. In the PolitiFact group, the bar values are 90.57, 85.85, 83.02, 89.62, 84.91, and 87.74, respectively. Across the entire chart, the tallest bar is the "Ours" configuration in the PolitiFact group at 90.57, while the shortest bar is the "w/o text" configuration in the PHEME group at 80.10. The bars are arranged in a fixed categorical sequence within each group rather than being sorted by numerical value.
